field.comment: Configuration of the source, for the database this might be the connectionId
field.name: sourceProperties

field.comment: Whether the data list should be normalized to a numeric list
field.name: normalize

field.comment: The field that contains the value (defaults to "value")
field.name: valueField

field.comment: The field that contains the label (defaults to "label")
field.name: labelField

field.comment: You can group values to create for instance stacked charts etc.
field.name: groupField

field.comment: Whether to reduce the list to a fact through aggregation
field.name: factualize

field.comment: When is it scheduled to run again?
field.name: scheduled

field.comment: sum, max, min, avg, count,... The aggregate can be used to compare data points.
field.name: aggregation

field.comment: You can accumulate entries over time (e.g. run every week, keep last x records). This contains the amount of records to keep. This is especially useful if the entries can not be calculated correctly historically. E.g. if you can only access the current state and not the history of state changes.
field.name: accumulation

field.comment: If it got deactivated due to exception, keep track of why
field.name: errorLog
